清冷仙子强行拜师，还逼签灵魂契约（清冷仙子强行拜师，还逼签灵魂契约（第22页）忽然，玉倾心素手抬起，葱白指尖越过天玄子，径直点向后方的墨羽。
那清冷孤傲的嗓音，犹如碎玉击冰，泠泠作响。
自己连气息都收敛了，这都能被点名？天玄子赶忙回应。
天玄子抹了把额头的冷汗，赶忙转头向叶汐湄解释。
“老师，这位大势力的姑娘找上门来，说要收编我们天玄仙宗。”
“她说只要让她当宗主，定能带领天玄仙宗走向强盛。”
“这种好机会……弟子自是得好好权衡一番。”
虽说对方是大势力出身的绝顶天骄，但与宗门无亲无故，怎么可能会对天玄仙宗真心上心？自己又怎么可能将老师一手创立的基业拱手让人？叶汐湄凤眸微凝。
不过，天玄仙宗毕竟是她亲手建立的，若不是自家人，任谁都别想染指。
她上下打量了玉倾心两眼，目光在那玲珑浮凸的极品身段上稍作流连，心中暗自称许。
资质绝顶，玉骨冰心，倒是个充实自家后宅的极品好苗子。
她刚准备回绝，不料，那玉倾心却抢先一步开了口。
“我加入你天玄仙宗，拜他为师。”
“走正统门规拜入山门，他日再将你击败，取下这宗主之位，如何？”
她玉指点着墨羽，虽是询问之语，可那冷傲的口吻，却连半点商量的余地都没有。
一上来就死死盯上了自己？难道自己身上有对方急需图谋的重宝？还是说这清冷仙子真就长了双慧眼，一眼便看穿了自己的气运潜力，赶着来搞投资？肩头，隐匿着的桃夭夭兴奋地扯了扯墨羽的头发，暗暗传音。
“长得那么高冷，没想到比夭夭还主动！”

墨羽给了她一个安静的眼神，桃夭夭乖巧地捂住小嘴。
天玄子脸色骤变，想都没想便要回绝。
就算杀了他，也绝不能让人对老师的亲传弟子图谋不轨！
叶汐湄却轻笑一声，直接拍板定音。
天玄子到嘴边的话硬生生噎了回去，满脸错愕。
玉倾心目光终于从墨羽身上移开，淡淡瞥了叶汐湄一眼。
“若你真要拜师，这位便是你的师祖。”
玉倾心面色毫无波澜，淡淡应了一声。
这些大势力出来的天骄都这般神经质吗？先是无缘无故来要宗门，又无缘无故要拜一个初次见面的人为师，还半点尊师重道的礼数都没有。
玉倾心不再理会旁人，径直看向墨羽。
“既然要拜师，自然不能光凭口头说说。”
她那莹白如玉的素手一翻，一张古朴神秘、泛着灵魂光晕的灵纸凭空浮现。
“此乃灵魂契约，签了，我们便是师徒。”

Fairy Qing Leng forced her to become a disciple, and even forced her to sign a soul contract (Fairy Qing Leng forced her to become a disciple, and even forced her to sign a soul contract (page 22)) Suddenly, Yu Qingxin raised her hand, her green-white fingertips passed over Tian Xuanzi, and pointed directly at Mo Yu who was behind him.
That cold and arrogant voice sounded like broken jade hitting ice.
He even restrained his breath, how could he be called out? Tian Xuanzi responded quickly.
Tian Xuanzi wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and quickly turned to explain to Ye Ximei.
"Teacher, this powerful girl came to our door and said she wanted to incorporate our Tianxuan Immortal Sect."
"She said that as long as she becomes the sect leader, she will definitely lead the Tianxuan Immortal Sect to greatness."
"This kind of good opportunity...disciple must weigh it carefully."
Although the other party is an extremely talented person from a powerful force, how can he be sincerely interested in the Tianxuan Immortal Sect if he is not related to the sect? How could I hand over the foundation created by my teacher to others? Ye Ximei's phoenix eyes narrowed slightly.
However, after all, Tianxuan Immortal Sect was established by her own hands. If it were not her own family, no one would be able to get involved.
She looked Yu Qingxin up and down, her eyes lingering on that exquisite and convex figure for a moment, and she secretly said yes in her heart.
Extremely qualified, jade-bone and ice-hearted, he is a great young talent to enrich his family.
She was just about to refuse, but unexpectedly, Nayu Qingxin spoke first.
"I will join your Tianxuan Immortal Sect and worship him as my teacher."
"Follow the orthodox sect rules and worship at the mountain gate. I will defeat you one day and take over the position of the sect leader. How about that?"
She pointed at Mo Yu with her jade finger. Although she was asking, her cold and arrogant tone left no room for negotiation.
Are you staring at yourself as soon as you come up? Could it be that he possesses a valuable treasure that the other party urgently needs to plot? Or does this cold fairy really have a pair of wise eyes, and he can see through his own luck potential at a glance, and rush to invest? Over her shoulder, the hidden Tao Yaoyao excitedly pulled Mo Yu's hair and secretly transmitted the message.
"You look so aloof, but I didn't expect you to be more proactive than Yaoyao!"
Mo Yu gave her a quiet look, and Tao Yaoyao obediently covered her mouth.
Tian Xuanzi's expression suddenly changed and he refused without even thinking.
Even if he is killed, he must not be allowed to plot evil against the teacher's direct disciples!
Ye Ximei chuckled lightly and immediately made the final decision.
Tian Xuanzi choked back what he said, his face full of astonishment.
Yu Qingxin finally moved her eyes away from Mo Yu and glanced at Ye Ximei lightly.
"If you really want to become a master, this will be your master."
Yu Qingxin's expression remained calm and she responded lightly.
Are all the geniuses from these big forces so neurotic? First, he came to the sect for no reason, and then he wanted to be his teacher to someone he met for the first time for no reason, and he didn't even have the slightest courtesy to respect his teacher.
Yu Qingxin stopped paying attention to others and looked directly at Mo Yu.
"Since you want to become a disciple, naturally you can't just rely on words."
She turned her jade-white hand, and a simple and mysterious spiritual paper with a halo of soul appeared out of thin air.
"This is a soul contract. Once we sign it, we will become master and disciple."
